name: סכום טור טלסקופי – מכנה ממעלה שלישית בעזרת שברים חלקיים (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Here is one with a cubic denominator: \[\sum_{n\geq {{CT:0}}} {{CT:1}}\]. Expand the general term into partial fractions in order to find the sum of the infinite series. 

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]

on_true.feedback:
Well done your answer is correct. Here you obtain a partial fraction decomposition:

\[a_n = {{CT:2}} \]

So that writing the sum out explicitly gives partial sums of the from 

\[s_m = \sum_{n={{CT:0}}}^{m} {{CT:2}} = \left({{CT:3}}+{{CT:4}}-{{CT:5}} \right) + \\ \left({{CT:6}}+{{CT:7}} -{{CT:8}} + \\  \left({{CT:9}}+{{CT:10}}-{{CT:11}} \right) + \ldots + \\  \left({{CT:12}}+{{CT:13}}-{{CT:14}} \right) + \\  \left({{CT:15}}+{{CT:16}}-{{CT:17}} \right)  = \\ {{CT:3}}+{{CT:4}}+{{CT:18}} +{{CT:19}}+{{CT:20}}-{{CT:21}}\]

Taking the limit as \(m \rightarrow \infty\) of this last expression gives the sum of the infinite sereis

\[\lim_{m \rightarrow \infty} s_m = {{CT:3}}+{{CT:22}}+{{CT:6}} = {{CT:23}}.\]
